events.text: Need a ladder to change a ceiling bulb
I’ll ask two awake neighbors who may have a suitable ladder.

events.item: ladder for changing a ceiling bulb

events.text: Do you have a stable ladder to lend for changing a ceiling bulb?
Hi Asma, do you have a stable ladder to lend for changing a ceiling bulb?
Got a 6ft aluminium step ladder in the hallway. Can lend—come by now or later this afternoon?
Hi — I don’t have a ladder here in 2B, sorry. I can help steady a small step stool if you have one, or I can come by at 16:00 to help hold a chair while you change it. Which would you prefer?
I’ll relay the offers and recommend the safer option.
Sulaiman can lend a 6ft aluminium step ladder now or later this afternoon; I recommend it over a chair, which is unsafe. Asma can steady a small step stool if you have one—which would you prefer?
I’ll arrange the ladder pickup and release the other offer.
Osama would like the ladder now. Can he pick it up at your 2A door?
Thank you for offering to help; your help won’t be needed this time.
I’ll confirm pickup with Sulaiman now.
Yeah. Tell Osama to come by 2A now. I’ll bring it to the door.
No problem — glad it's sorted. If you need anything later (a hand, flashlight, or someone to check the bulb area), I’m around.
Yes please, go with your recommendation
The pickup is confirmed, so I’ll let Osama know.
Sulaiman will bring the ladder to his 2A door now; please pick it up there.
